diagnosis: Customer is on Unified Auth and needs guidance on rotating scoped API keys. No immediate escalation required as this aligns with documented procedures.
reply: For accounts using Unified Auth, API tokens are managed as scoped keys rather than a single account-wide credential. To reset your token, follow these steps in our [Scoped API Keys guide](https://support.example.com/kb-0003): create a new key with the required scopes, update your application to use the new key, and then revoke the old key. Revocation is immediate, so plan for a seamless transition. Let us know if you need further clarification on scopes or migration steps.
